correctness.rationale: KKT on face S gives a_i x_i=1/Z_S for active coordinates and zero inactive gradient, forcing an unseen vertex as any vertex linear-minimization solution when S is incomplete. Since old and new supports are disjoint, f((1−gamma)x^S+gamma e_j)=(1−gamma)^2/(2Z_S)+a_j gamma²/2; exact 1-D minimization yields gamma=a_j^−1/(Z_S+a_j^−1). Substitution equals inverse-curvature weights on enlarged support, proving induction to full support. I inspected the actual nested artifacts/verify_fw_diagonal_simplex.py with exact Fraction arithmetic and independently checked several positive-diagonal examples and the four-coordinate chain (1,2,3,6). Formula and uniqueness require aligned coordinates, positive a_i, a VERTEX oracle and initial face minimizer; arbitrary convex combinations of tied vertices are explicitly excluded.
residual_risks: Arbitrary convex-combination linear oracle, mixed starting point, inexact line search, dense Hessian or floating-point finite termination are not covered.

value.rationale: A clean exact algorithmic collapse (ordinary line search equals fully corrective optimization) with m−1 finite termination from a vertex is a motivated and reusable structural benchmark. It explains when the computationally cheaper update automatically produces globally reoptimized weights, provides exact objective/gap values and a boundary to generic FW sublinear iteration results.
residual_risks: Not robust to inexact arithmetic, nonvertex oracle, or a rotated/dense positive-definite quadratic.

final_claim: For every positive diagonal quadratic on the probability simplex, exact vertex-oracle and exact line-search Frank–Wolfe started at the unique minimizer x^S of any nonempty face selects an unseen vertex and lands precisely on the enlarged-face minimizer with gamma=1/(1+a_j Z_S). It reaches the global minimizer in m−|S| steps; along the trajectory f=1/(2Z_S), FW gap=1/Z_S.
limitations: Exact vertex oracle, exact line search, initial face minimizer, diagonal positive Hessian aligned with simplex only.
